decisions.reason: We keep it because it supports planners and can help win related weir and gate projects, though as a lighter stand-alone web tool it remains the easiest item to rationalize.
We keep it because it is the retained fouling product after the 2024 portfolio cleanup and fits our integrated monitoring and efficiency offer for operating infrastructure.
We keep it because the spring-controlled flap weir is close to our hydraulic-structure business and broadens the solution set for municipalities and operators with limited added complexity.
We keep it because energy management for water facilities is directly in line with our strategic move toward digital networking, efficiency, and energy recovery.
We keep it because the overflow flap gate is a core water-level-regulation product line, already presented prominently, and complements our engineering and automation projects.
